newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT JAN/FEB SUEZ CANAL, TOURISM RECEIPTS UP.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT JAN/FEB SUEZ CANAL, TOURISM RECEIPTS UP.

text.p: Egypt earned a total $836.3 million from tourism and Suez Canal receipts for January and February 1997 compared to $742.1 million in the same 1996 period, government statistics showed.

The Cabinet Information and Decision Support Centre said in a bulletin made available on Thursday that tourism receipts for February 1997 stood at $247 million, down from $302 million in January. The Suez Canal earnings were also lower in February at $134.9 million from $152.4 million in the previous month.
The canal earned Egypt $145 million and $163.1 million in February and January 1996. Tourism receipts were $248 and $186 million for the same period.
Tourism and the Suez Canal net Egypt a bulk of its foreign currency income.
